deviceId.meaning: ID of a PJLink device declared in the carapace profile; HTTP defaults a missing or non-string value to the empty string.

dryRun.meaning: When true, use the profile-backed dry-run path instead of the operation; omitted or non-boolean HTTP values default to false.
Whether the profile-backed scan was selected.

product.meaning: Profile or queried product identity, or null if unavailable.

manufacturer.meaning: PJLink manufacturer value, or null when absent.

productName.meaning: PJLink productName value, or null when absent.

otherInfo.meaning: PJLink otherInfo value, or null when absent.

class.meaning: PJLink class value, or null when absent.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: The enum lists fixed literal outcomes. Open forms can also appear: caduceus-pjlink-device-invalid:<serde error>, caduceus-pjlink-resolve-failed:<OS error>, caduceus-pjlink-connect-failed:<OS error>, caduceus-pjlink-read-timeout-set-failed:<OS error>, caduceus-pjlink-write-timeout-set-failed:<OS error>, caduceus-pjlink-stream-clone-failed:<OS error>, caduceus-pjlink-greeting-read-failed:<OS error>, caduceus-pjlink-write-failed:<OS error>, caduceus-pjlink-flush-failed:<OS error>, caduceus-pjlink-response-read-failed:<OS error>. Also caduceus-pjlink-product-scan-invalid:<serialization error>.
